en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ja'abi narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Mudarik ibn Tamam al-Shaybani narrated to us, saying: Zakariya ibn al-Hakam Abu Yahya al-Rasbi narrated to us, saying: Khalaf ibn Tamim narrated to us, saying: Bakr ibn Habish narrated from Abu Shaybah, from Abdul Malik ibn Umar, from Abu Qura, from Salman al-Farsi (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Prophet (saw) said to me:

"O Salman, when you wake up in the morning, say: 'O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no partner for You. We have entered the morning, and the kingdom belongs to Allah, there is no partner for Him.' Say it three times. And when you enter the evening, say the same, for they will atone for the sins committed between them."
